title: eludite.workspace.view input
description: The Workspace window's switches and actions (brief 0073). Each switch given is set; the answer holds the switches as they are after the call. `collapseAll` collapses every node but the root; `syncActive` reveals and selects the active document's node (Sync with Active Document, Ctrl+[, S); `refresh` lists the workspace again and has the host re-evaluate the projects.

showAllFiles.description: Show All Files: also list what is on disk under a project's folder but not in the project (bin and obj too), muted.

fileNesting.description: File Nesting: nest files by Visual Studio's default rules (appsettings.Development.json under appsettings.json). On by default.

trackActiveItem.description: Track Active Item: reveal the active document's node whenever the active document changes. On by default.
